finding.summary: A retained fina_indicator body did not prove caller-supplied intraday announced_at or available_at values.

luna_max_review_before_fix.key_observation: The verifier received only an artifact reference and could not recompute an exact unique source-row relationship. Tushare anns_d is a separate dataset and exposes no documented financial-period link.

luna_max_final_review_before_publication.key_observation: The typed boundary remained declarative: Publication did not independently re-run a verifier, and no concrete retained-body/source-time repository verifier was wired.

luna_max_final_review_after_publication_.key_observation: Canonical writes plus ordinary/current Publication now default-deny and pass the complete decision evidence to the verifier. The remaining P1 is the missing concrete two-artifact/audit verifier and production composition wiring; a callback test double is not production proof.

implemented_contract.legacy_readability: v1 decodes but is ineligible for current Publication
implemented_contract.application_gate: The verifier receives complete decision evidence and must recompute the unique row match from both retained financial and source-time bodies plus audit evidence.
implemented_contract.repository_gate: Canonical bulk_upsert denies writes unless an independent source-time evidence verifier is injected and returns true.
implemented_contract.publication_gate: Persisted source-time witness, row clocks, dimensions and transport/contract metadata must match exactly; candidate selection also requires the independent verifier to recheck the complete decision evidence.
implemented_contract.current_runtime: No production source-time verifier is wired and current adapters construct no positive witness; the path remains fail-closed.

provider_contract_status.tushare_fina_indicator: Official fields include date-only ann_date and end_date; they do not provide an intraday availability timestamp.
provider_contract_status.tushare_anns_d: Official fields include ann_date and optional rec_time, but the API is separate and exposes no documented end_date relationship to a fina_indicator row.
prohibited_inferences: join only on ts_code plus ann_date
use response completion as provider-native available_at
